title: VoiceTelephonyGroupOvride - Tooling API
description: Represents group-level telephony settings that override the default org-level configuration. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

UserGroupId.description: Unique ID of the group to which the telephony configuration override applies. Each group can have only one override assignment. This field is a relationship field.

VoiceTelephonyDefinitionId.description: ID of the voice telephony configuration associated with the override. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must enable Salesforce Voice Contact Center Admin for Amazon Connect and Salesforce Voice Contact Center Admin (Partner Telephony) for partner telephony providers.
